title: write.done@1
description: A write's receipt (#1577): an app or CLI write with an effect, sent with a request ID, landed, and this is what its caller was told. It commits in the same FULL commit as the write's own event, right after it, so a crash leaves both or neither. The same device, ID and params get this result back and write nothing; the same ID with other params is refused, naming the ID. Only the core appends it.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

method.description: The socket method the write called, such as ask.answer.

request.description: The write's request ID, as its caller sent it: 1 to 64 letters, digits, - or _.

device.description: Who sent it: the paired device that signed it, device:<id>, or the connection's role (app or cli) for a write no device signed.

params.description: The lower-case hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 bytes of the write's params with signature and request left out: what a retry must send again to get this result.

event.description: The write's own event, which this receipt commits with: the one whose log_pos its reply carried, or the answer.refused of a late answer, whose retry gets the same refusal. Absent for a write that appended no event of its own (an overrule already made), whose receipt keeps its result instead.

result.x-opaque: the result the write's caller was told, for a write that appended no event of its own; a retry gets it back
